content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the removal of the Makefile rule for CONFIG_PCIE_TEGRA194, which prevented the pcie-tegra.c file from being built as a module. Additionally, the introduction of conditional compilation around the native driver code using CONFIG_PCIE_TEGRA194 caused issues because this configuration is only defined when the driver is built-in, not when it is built as a module. Furthermore, the addition of symbols that were always defined but only used when CONFIG_PCIEASPM was set led to warnings when CONFIG_PCIEASPM was not enabled. These changes collectively resulted in build regressions for the Tegra194 PCIe driver.
